scripts.postbuild: rm -f extension-chrome.zip extension-firefox.zip && (cd dist && zip -qr ../extension-chrome.zip .) && (cd dist-firefox && zip -qr ../extension-firefox.zip .)
scripts.build:e2e: vite build --mode e2e --outDir dist-e2e && bun postbuildfixes.ts dist-e2e
scripts.build:local: vite build --mode foxslash-local --outDir dist-local && bun postbuildfixes.ts dist-local
scripts.package:source: rm -f extension-source.zip && git ls-files -z | xargs -0 zip -q extension-source.zip
scripts.publish:firefox: rm -rf release-firefox && unzip -q extension-firefox.zip -d release-firefox && web-ext sign --source-dir release-firefox --channel listed --upload-source-code extension-source.zip --approval-timeout 0 --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts
scripts.build:unpacked: vite build --mode unpacked --outDir dist-unpacked && bun postbuildfixes.ts dist-unpacked
